title: Lowest Common Ancestor of Deepest Leaves
summary: Given a binary tree, identify the lowest common ancestor of the deepest leaves.
statement: Given a binary tree, identify the lowest common ancestor of the deepest leaves. A leaf node has no children, and the depth of the root is zero. The depth of a node increases by one for each level below the root. The lowest common ancestor of a set of nodes is the deepest node that has all nodes in the set within its subtree.
constraints: Return the lowest common ancestor subtree of every deepest leaf.
